I don't usually leave reviews, although I feel the need to share my experience. I recently bought 2 baby rats from here on Sunday 11/9/25 and they were quite little but I don't think that was the whole problem. At first I thought they were just scared so I let them have the rest of the day to settle down. The next few days one of the boys, Ratigan, started running around and taking treats. He was getting comfortable with his cage and environment. However, my other boy Parmesan, just layed in the tissue box and kept shaking. His eyes were squinting, he was breathing with his mouth open, and he had discharge from his eyes and nose. I couldn't get to a vet that night and by this morning 11/13/25 I found him deceased in the tissue box. I believe he passed from a URI. I'm absolutely devastated about his passing, but he was definitely sick when he was sold to me. He could not have just gotten sick and declined that quickly.This is not a hate review on the store, it's a warning to anyone who is looking to purchase a rat or possibly any animal from this place.
